papers.title: Many Objective Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract: Some real problems require the evaluation of expensive and noisy objective functions. Moreover, the analytical expression of these objective functions may be unknown. These functions are known as black-boxes, for example, estimating the generalization error of a machine learning algorithm and computing its prediction time in terms of its hyper-parameters. Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) is a set of methods that has been successfully applied for the simultaneous optimization of black-boxes. Concretely, BO methods rely on a probabilistic model of the objective functions, typically a Gaussian process. This model generates a predictive distribution of the objectives. However, MOBO methods have problems when the number of objectives in a multi-objective optimization problem are 3 or more, which is the many objective setting. In particular, the BO process is more costly as more objectives are considered, computing the quality of the solution via the hyper-volume is also more costly and, most importantly, we have to evaluate every objective function, wasting expensive computational, economic or other resources. However, as more objectives are involved in the optimization problem, it is highly probable that some of them are redundant and not add information about the problem solution. A measure that represents how similar are GP predictive distributions is proposed. We also propose a many objective Bayesian optimization algorithm that uses this metric to determine whether two objectives are redundant. The algorithm stops evaluating one of them if the similarity is found, saving resources and not hurting the performance of the multi-objective BO algorithm. We show empirical evidence in a set of toy, synthetic, benchmark and real experiments that GPs predictive distributions of the effectiveness of the metric and the algorithm.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多目标贝叶斯优化方法可减少昂贵仿真评估次数，适用于生物力学植入物设计的多目标优化场景。
llm.why_not_core: Does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design problems, and lacks explicit uncertainty quantification emphasis beyond standard GP.

summary_zh.motivation: 多目标贝叶斯优化在目标数增加时计算成本高，且存在冗余目标浪费资源。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于GP预测分布相似性的冗余目标检测方法，停止评估冗余目标以节省资源。
summary_zh.result: 在玩具、合成、基准和真实实验中验证了方法有效性，不降低优化性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验和真实案例进行性能验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization becomes computationally expensive as the number of objectives increases, and redundant objectives waste resources.
summary_en.method: A metric based on the similarity of Gaussian process predictive distributions is proposed to detect redundant objectives, and the algorithm stops evaluating one of them if redundancy is found.
summary_en.result: Empirical evidence on toy, synthetic, benchmark, and real experiments shows that the proposed method saves resources without harming optimization performance.
summary_en.validation: Validation is conducted via numerical benchmarks and real-world experiments.

papers.title: Scaling Gaussian Processes with Derivative Information Using Variational Inference
papers.abstract: Gaussian processes with derivative information are useful in many settings where derivative information is available, including numerous Bayesian optimization and regression tasks that arise in the natural sciences. Incorporating derivative observations, however, comes with a dominating $O(N^3D^3)$ computational cost when training on $N$ points in $D$ input dimensions. This is intractable for even moderately sized problems. While recent work has addressed this intractability in the low-$D$ setting, the high-$N$, high-$D$ setting is still unexplored and of great value, particularly as machine learning problems increasingly become high dimensional. In this paper, we introduce methods to achieve fully scalable Gaussian process regression with derivatives using variational inference. Analogous to the use of inducing values to sparsify the labels of a training set, we introduce the concept of inducing directional derivatives to sparsify the partial derivative information of a training set. This enables us to construct a variational posterior that incorporates derivative information but whose size depends neither on the full dataset size $N$ nor the full dimensionality $D$. We demonstrate the full scalability of our approach on a variety of tasks, ranging from a high dimensional stellarator fusion regression task to training graph convolutional neural networks on Pubmed using Bayesian optimization. Surprisingly, we find that our approach can improve regression performance even in settings where only label data is available.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法为高斯过程回归的可扩展性提供了新思路，可迁移至有限元代理模型的构建中，尤其适用于带导数信息的优化问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, does not address constraint handling, and lacks validation on implant or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维大数据场景下含导数高斯过程回归计算成本过高的问题
summary_zh.method: 引入诱导方向导数，结合变分推断实现稀疏化
summary_zh.result: 实现了与数据集规模和维度无关的可扩展高斯过程回归，在多个高维任务中表现良好
summary_zh.validation: 在恒星聚变回归和图神经网络贝叶斯优化任务上进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational intractability of Gaussian process regression with derivative information in high-dimensional, large-scale settings.
summary_en.method: Introduces inducing directional derivatives to sparsify derivative information within a variational inference framework.
summary_en.result: Achieves fully scalable GP regression with derivatives, independent of dataset size and dimensionality, validated on high-dimensional tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on stellarator fusion regression and Bayesian optimization for graph neural networks.

papers.title: Explainable AI (XAI) for PHM of Industrial Asset: A State-of-The-Art, PRISMA-Compliant Systematic Review
papers.abstract: A state-of-the-art systematic review on XAI applied to Prognostic and Health Management (PHM) of industrial asset is presented. This work provides an overview of the general trend of XAI in PHM, answers the question of accuracy versus explainability, the extent of human involvement, the explanation assessment and uncertainty quantification in PHM-XAI domain. Research articles associated with the subject, from 2015 to 2021 were selected from five known databases following PRISMA guidelines. Data was then extracted from the selected articles and examined. Several findings were synthesized. Firstly, while the discipline is still young, the analysis indicated the growing acceptance of XAI in PHM domain. Secondly, XAI functions as a double edge sword, where it is assimilated as a tool to execute PHM tasks as well as a mean of explanation, particularly in diagnostic and anomaly detection activities, implying a real need for XAI in PHM. Thirdly, the review showed that PHM-XAI papers produce either good or excellent result in general, suggesting that PHM performance is unaffected by XAI. Fourthly, human role, evaluation metrics and uncertainty management are areas requiring further attention by the PHM community. Adequate assessment metrics to cater for PHM need are urgently needed.Finally, most case study featured on the accepted articles are based on real, industrial data, indicating that the available PHM-XAI blends are fit to solve complex,real-world challenges, increasing the confidence in AI adoption in the industry.

llm.relevance_to_user: 与FEA替代模型、植入物力学设计或约束优化无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a systematic review on XAI for industrial PHM, lacking any FEA surrogate methods, constraint handling, UQ, or implant/biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述XAI在工业资产健康管理中的应用趋势。
summary_zh.method: 遵循PRISMA指南的系统性文献综述。
summary_zh.result: XAI在PHM中接受度上升，但评估指标和不确定性管理需进一步关注。
summary_zh.validation: 基于多数据库文献筛选和分析。

summary_en.motivation: To systematically review the state-of-the-art of explainable AI applied to prognostic and health management of industrial assets.
summary_en.method: A PRISMA-compliant systematic review of articles from 2015 to 2021 across five databases.
summary_en.result: XAI is increasingly accepted in PHM, with good performance; however, human role, evaluation metrics, and uncertainty management require further attention.
summary_en.validation: The review synthesizes findings from selected research articles, many based on real industrial data.

papers.title: Lattice thermal conductivity of half-Heuslers with density functional theory and machine learning: Enhancing predictivity by active sampling with principal component analysis
papers.abstract: Low lattice thermal conductivity is essential for high thermoelectric performance of a material. Lattice thermal conductivity is often computed using density functional theory (DFT), typically at a high computational cost. Training machine learning models to predict lattice thermal conductivity could offer an effective procedure to identify low lattice thermal conductivity compounds. However, in doing so, we must face the fact that such compounds can be quite rare and distinct from those in a typical training set. This distinctness can be problematic as standard machine learning methods are inaccurate when predicting properties of compounds with features differing significantly from those in the training set. By computing the lattice thermal conductivity of 122 half-Heusler compounds, using the temperature-dependent effective potential method, we generate a data set to explore this issue. We first show how random forest regression can fail to identify low lattice thermal conductivity compounds with random selection of training data. Next, we show how active selection of training data using feature and principal component analysis can be used to improve model performance and the ability to identify low lattice thermal conductivity compounds. Lastly, we find that active learning without the use of DFT-based features can be viable as a quicker way of selecting samples.

llm.relevance_to_user: 此论文研究材料热导率的机器学习预测，与FEA替代模型和生物力学设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomechanics or implant context, no uncertainty quantification, and only passive use of DFT data.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高机器学习预测低热导率化合物的准确性
summary_zh.method: 用主动学习结合主成分分析选择训练样本
summary_zh.result: 主动采样可提升对罕见低热导率化合物的预测能力
summary_zh.validation: 基于122种半Heusler化合物的DFT计算数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve ML predictive accuracy for rare low lattice thermal conductivity compounds.
summary_en.method: Active learning with principal component analysis is used to select informative training samples from DFT computed data.
summary_en.result: Active sampling enhances identification of compounds with low thermal conductivity compared to random sampling.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a dataset of 122 half-Heusler compounds computed using DFT with the temperature-dependent effective potential method.

papers.title: MOD-Net: A Machine Learning Approach via Model-Operator-Data Network for Solving PDEs
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a a machine learning approach via model-operator-data network (MOD-Net) for solving PDEs. A MOD-Net is driven by a model to solve PDEs based on operator representation with regularization from data. For linear PDEs, we use a DNN to parameterize the Green's function and obtain the neural operator to approximate the solution according to the Green's method. To train the DNN, the empirical risk consists of the mean squared loss with the least square formulation or the variational formulation of the governing equation and boundary conditions. For complicated problems, the empirical risk also includes a few labels, which are computed on coarse grid points with cheap computation cost and significantly improves the model accuracy. Intuitively, the labeled dataset works as a regularization in addition to the model constraints. The MOD-Net solves a family of PDEs rather than a specific one and is much more efficient than original neural operator because few expensive labels are required. We numerically show MOD-Net is very efficient in solving Poisson equation and one-dimensional radiative transfer equation. For nonlinear PDEs, the nonlinear MOD-Net can be similarly used as an ansatz for solving nonlinear PDEs, exemplified by solving several nonlinear PDE problems, such as the Burgers equation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的MOD-Net方法可用于高效求解偏微分方程族，有望迁移至生物力学中的代理模型构建。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or application to implant/biomechanics design; it focuses solely on solving PDEs without experimental or biomechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高求解偏微分方程族的效率，减少对昂贵标签数据的依赖。
summary_zh.method: 用深度神经网络参数化格林函数，结合模型方程与少量标签数据构建混合损失函数。
summary_zh.result: 在泊松方程和辐射传输方程上展现了高效性和准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与标准神经网络算子对比。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve families of PDEs with reduced reliance on expensive labeled data by combining model-based constraints with data.
summary_en.method: A deep neural network parametrizes the Green's function, and the loss function includes both the governing equation variational form and a few coarse-grid data points.
summary_en.result: The MOD-Net achieves high accuracy and efficiency on Poisson, radiative transfer, and Burgers equations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks comparing with standard neural operator methods on linear and nonlinear PDEs.

papers.title: The in-situ β phase reinforced Ti/Zr-based bulk metallic glass matrix composite by selective laser melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究金属玻璃复合材料的增材制造，未涉及多孔结构或生物力学匹配，与生物医用植入物方向相关性较低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光选区熔化制备Ti/Zr基金属玻璃复合材料的微观结构与力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to investigate the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti/Zr-based bulk metallic glass matrix composites fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: The composite was fabricated via SLM with in-situ formation of β phase reinforcement.
summary_en.result: The composite exhibited enhanced mechanical properties due to the β phase reinforcement.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructural characterization were performed to validate the material performance.
